answer: Anti-sybil via burn-to-register plus a random live audit. Every agent identity must burn 250 POA once to register and stake 1,000 POA; each epoch a random 5% of identities face a live challenge they must answer within 60 seconds from their registered device fingerprint, and missing it slashes the full 1,000 POA stake. An attacker wanting 100 fake identities must burn 25,000 POA and lock 100,000 POA, while one honest agent pays only the 250 POA burn once. The words are haven, zenith, opal.
